newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies Snohomish County, Wash., term bonds.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies Snohomish County, Wash., term bonds.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp said Tuesday it qualified for bond insurance under its optional bidding program the 2019 term bonds on Snohomish County, Wash.'s $3.857 million improvement bond deal, scheduled for competitive sale today.

MBIA said its qualification covers the stated 2019 term bond and interest accruing thereon. The estimated redemption payment scheduled for the 2019 term bond is not covered by the insurance, the company said.
